title: HR Manager
description:
Department: Human Resources  
Designation: HR Manager  
Industry : Pharmaceuticals  
Location: Kolkata / New Town, West Bengal

Job Summary

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing and coordinating the organisation’s human resource functions, including talent acquisition, employee lifecycle management, HR operations, performance management, employee engagement, policy implementation, training and development, and statutory compliance coordination. The role requires close collaboration with management and business teams to ensure effective workforce planning, smooth HR operations, improved employee productivity and alignment of HR practices with organisational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment**

- Manage end-to-end recruitment for sales, managerial, corporate and support functions across multiple locations.

- Understand manpower requirements, prepare job descriptions and develop recruitment strategies in coordination with hiring managers.

- Source, screen and evaluate candidates through CV screening, interviews, written assessments and case studies.

- Coordinate interview rounds, candidate shortlisting, salary discussions, offer releases and joining formalities.

- Monitor recruitment progress, vacancy status, hiring timelines and manpower requirements.

- Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers and hiring reports.

**2. HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management**

- Manage employee onboarding, documentation, induction, confirmation, transfers, role changes and separation processes.

- Maintain employee records, personnel files, attendance, leave records and HR databases.

- Prepare and issue appointment letters, confirmation letters, employment-related notices, experience letters and other HR communications.

- Coordinate employee exit formalities, notice-period compliance, full and final settlements and clearance procedures.

- Track employee tenure, probation status, confirmation eligibility and workforce movements.

- Maintain accurate employee master data and prepare periodic HR reports.

**3. Payroll and Compensation Administration**

- Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary inputs, attendance adjustments, leave deductions and loss-of-pay calculations.

- Verify salary structures, CTC breakups, statutory deductions and employee compensation records.

- Coordinate payroll-related queries, reimbursement processing and full and final settlement calculations.

- Administer employee benefits, including group mediclaim, employee referral benefits and other company-sponsored welfare initiatives.

- Coordinate with Finance and external service providers to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.

**4. HR Policies and Employee Relations**

- Develop, review and implement HR policies, employee handbooks, standard operating procedures and internal guidelines.

- Ensure consistent implementation of company policies relating to attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, performance, conduct and separation.

- Handle employee grievances, workplace concerns, disciplinary matters and management escalations.

- Draft formal HR communications and employment-related documentation in line with company policy and applicable employment laws.

- Coordinate statutory compliance requirements and maintain relevant documentation in consultation with management and external advisors.

**5. Performance Management and Employee Assessment**

- Coordinate employee performance reviews, KPI tracking, appraisal processes and performance documentation.

- Develop and administer candidate assessments, competency evaluations, managerial case studies and written tests.

- Analyse assessment results and prepare evaluation reports to support management decisions.

- Monitor performance-related concerns and coordinate improvement plans with reporting managers.

- Support management in workforce productivity, employee retention and performance improvement initiatives.

**6. Learning and Development**

- Identify training requirements in consultation with functional heads and reporting managers.

- Plan and coordinate employee induction, product training, scientific training and functional development programmes.

- Coordinate with internal subject-matter experts, external trainers and qualified medical professionals for relevant training initiatives.

- Organise training calendars, assessments, feedback collection and training effectiveness reviews.

- Maintain training records and monitor employee participation and development progress.

**7. HR Analytics and Management Reporting**

- Prepare periodic reports on headcount, recruitment, attrition, employee tenure, probation, attendance and workforce movements.

- Analyse employee turnover and identify trends relating to retention, recruitment effectiveness and workforce stability.

- Prepare manpower reports, organisational charts, employee databases and management presentations.

- Maintain HR trackers, dashboards and structured reporting systems to support data-driven decision-making.

- Assist management with HR planning, organisational restructuring and workforce-related analysis.

**8. Employee Engagement and Benefits Administration**

- Coordinate employee engagement activities, internal announcements, employee welfare initiatives and company communications.

- Manage employee referral programmes and coordinate eligibility and benefit processing.

- Administer group mediclaim enrolment, renewal coordination and employee-related insurance queries.

- Support initiatives aimed at employee retention, workplace discipline and organisational culture.

**9. Coordination with Business and Functional Teams**

- Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Administration and senior management to address manpower and employee-related requirements.

- Support recruitment and workforce planning for field sales teams across multiple territories and reporting levels.

- Coordinate organisational structures, reporting relationships, team allocation and employee master data updates.

- Assist management in implementing HR initiatives aligned with business expansion and operational requirements.

**Qualifications and Experience**

- Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.

- Relevant experience in HR generalist and HR operations functions; pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience preferred.

- Strong working knowledge of recruitment, employee documentation, payroll coordination, HR policies and performance management.

- Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and HR reporting tools.

- Strong communication, organisational, analytical and interpersonal skills.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
  
  
We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
  
  
RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Senior Recruiter based in our Bangalore office, you will run full-cycle hiring across a mix of roles at RZR and bring senior-level judgment to every search you own. You will report to our Global Head of Talent Acquisition and work closely with them on how the team hires.
  
  
You will be the go-to recruiting partner for our revenue leaders across Sales, Business Development, Account Management, and Marketing. You will also take on our more complex, hard-to-fill searches, where market knowledge and creative sourcing make the difference.
  
  
We're looking for someone who operates independently, advises leaders with data, and knows how to close candidates who have options.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Revenue Hiring
  
  

* Own full-cycle recruiting for revenue and revenue-adjacent roles across Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Marketing, and Revenue Operations, from intake through offer acceptance

* Build and maintain warm talent pipelines for recurring revenue roles so no search starts from zero

Niche and Hard-to-Fill Roles
  
  

* Lead searches for specialized roles with small talent pools, using market mapping, targeted outreach, and creative channel strategy
* Produce talent market insights, including compensation benchmarks, competitor org mapping, and talent availability, that shape hiring decisions

Recruiting Craft and Team
  
  

* Run high-stakes closes alongside hiring managers, including counteroffers, competing offers, and complex negotiations

* Deep knowledge of the Bangalore and broader India talent market

Nice to Have

Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist – Technical & Healthcare Operations

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Work Mode: 100% Work from Office (Tuesday to Saturday, all working days)

Employment Type: Full-Time Experience: 4–8 years (preferably)

Department: Human Resources/Talent Acquisition

About ScribeEMR

ScribeEMR is a healthcare technology and services company supporting US healthcare providers through medical scribing, healthcare documentation, revenue cycle management, medical coding, and technology-enabled healthcare solutions. We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and results-driven recruitment professional who can independently manage hiring across technical and healthcare operations functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Recruitment – Highest Priority

• Lead end-to-end recruitment for software development, engineering, and IT infrastructure positions.

• Recruit software professionals across technologies such as Python, Java, .NET, JavaScript, React, Node.js, AI/ML, cloud technologies, DevOps, QA, and related engineering roles.

• Source and recruit networking, systems administration, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technical support professionals.

• Demonstrate a sound understanding of technical job requirements, technology stacks, and candidate skill sets.

• Conduct effective initial technical screening to evaluate candidates' relevant experience, technical exposure, communication skills, and suitability.

• Work closely with engineering and technology leadership to understand hiring requirements and deliver suitable candidates within agreed timelines.

2. Healthcare Operations Recruitment

Manage recruitment for the following departments, in order of business priority:

• Medical Scribing: Medical scribes, senior scribes, quality analysts, trainers, team leads, and operations managers.

• VMOS (Virtual Medical Office Services): Virtual medical assistants, patient coordinators, appointment scheduling professionals, and related healthcare support roles.

• Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Medical billing, payment posting, accounts receivable, denial management, insurance verification, and related RCM roles.

• Medical Coding: Certified and non-certified medical coders, coding auditors, quality analysts, and coding team leads. Prior experience in healthcare recruitment will be an added advantage, but strong technical recruitment experience is mandatory.

3. End-to-End Recruitment Management

• Independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to candidate joining.

• Develop sourcing strategies using Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, employee referrals, professional networks, and other relevant channels.

• Conduct initial screening, coordinate interviews, negotiate compensation, and facilitate offer rollouts.

• Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and anticipated hiring needs.

• Proactively identify and approach passive candidates, particularly for specialized technical positions.

• Coordinate with department heads and hiring managers to ensure timely closure of open positions.

• Manage candidate follow-ups, offer acceptance, and joining conversion to minimize candidate dropouts.

• Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, hiring reports, and candidate databases.

4. Recruitment Planning & Performance

• Understand departmental manpower requirements and prioritize recruitment based on business needs.

• Track recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, offer-to-joining ratio, sourcing effectiveness, and hiring quality.

• Provide regular updates to management on recruitment progress, challenges, and expected closures.

• Build talent pipelines for difficult-to-fill and business-critical positions.

• Recommend improvements to recruitment processes and sourcing strategies.

5. Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred but not mandatory.

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on technical recruitment experience is mandatory.

• Overall recruitment experience of approximately 4–8 years preferred.

• Proven experience recruiting software developers, engineers, networking professionals, and IT infrastructure personnel.

• Strong familiarity with technical terminology, programming languages, frameworks, and IT roles. • Demonstrated ability to independently source, screen, shortlist, and close candidates.

• Hands-on experience with Naukri Recruiter, LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, and other sourcing tools.

• Good understanding of salary benchmarking, offer negotiation, and candidate engagement.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills. • Ability to handle multiple positions simultaneously and work with minimal supervision.

• Willingness to work from the Bengaluru office on all scheduled working days.

6. Preferred Experience

• Recruitment experience in healthcare IT, health-tech, medical scribing, RCM, or medical coding organizations.

• Experience recruiting for US healthcare-related operations based in India.

• Prior experience managing both technical and non-technical hiring.

• Experience working in a fast-growing organization with changing recruitment priorities.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on:

• Timely closure of technical and healthcare operations vacancies.

• Quality and suitability of shortlisted candidates.

• Offer acceptance and candidate joining rates.

• Effectiveness of proactive sourcing and talent pipeline development.

• Hiring manager satisfaction and recruitment process efficiency.

• Ability to independently close challenging technical positions.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a hands-on recruiter, not merely a recruitment coordinator or HR generalist. The ideal candidate should have a strong track record in technical recruitment, be comfortable discussing technical requirements with engineering managers, and possess the ability to independently identify and attract suitable candidates. The person should also be adaptable and willing to recruit across healthcare operations functions as business requirements evolve.

Important: Candidates without prior hands-on technical recruitment experience will not be considered.

Work Location & Expectations This is a full-time, office-based position in Bengaluru. The selected candidate must be available to work from the office on all scheduled working days. Remote or hybrid working arrangements are not available for this role.

Reporting Hierarchy: Executive Director and Department Head, Human Resources Compensation Offered: Commensurate with experience and as per industry standards

Additional Perks: Non-Reimbursable:-

⚫ Medical insurance of 4 lakhs per annum. Coverage is for self, spouse, and 2 children under 25 years of age.

⚫ Group Personal Accident Policy coverage for the employee with payment of 5 years’ CTC in case of death of the employee in an accident.

⚫ Office-based employees shall be eligible for complimentary canteen facilities.

How to Apply: Apply through our website https://www.scribeemr.in/

NOTES: Please visit the following website to know more about us ➔ https://www.scribeemr.in/ If you still have any questions, please write to technical.recruiter@scribeemr.in

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Title - HR Manager

Location - Bangalore, India

Company - King Rose Construction & Services

**About Us**

King Rose Construction & Services is a leading general contractor and outsourced services provider headquartered in New York City, recognized for delivering complex, high profile projects with excellence and precision. As we enter a significant phase of growth — expanding operations across the U.S. and building out our Bangalore team —we are seeking a seasoned HR leader to architect and lead our people strategy at scale.

**Position Overview**

The HR Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing King Rose’s people strategy across our U.S. and India operations. We are looking for a strategic partner to the executive team who can build scalable HR infrastructure, lead high volume international recruiting, and foster a performance-driven, inclusive culture across geographies. You will be based in our Bangalore office and work during evening shift hours (4:30 PM – 1:00 AM IST), aligning closely with our New York headquarters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition & Recruiting**

* Lead end-to-end recruiting operations for both U.S. and India-based roles, managing high volume pipelines across technical, operational, and leadership positions.
* Build and manage sourcing strategies for the Indian market, including partnerships with Universities, recruitment agencies, and digital platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and Shine.
* Own U.S. hiring operations, including managing job board presence, and ensuring compliance requirements.
* Develop employer branding initiatives to position King Rose as an employer of choice in both markets.
* Establish structured interview frameworks, offer management processes, and onboarding programs that create a consistent and high-quality candidate experience.
* Build workforce planning models in partnership with department heads to anticipate headcount needs 3–6 months ahead.

**HR Strategy & Organizational Development**

* Partner with the leadership team to design and execute a people strategy that supports aggressive scaling across both geographies.
* Lead organizational design efforts including role clarity, reporting structures, and team architecture as the company grows.
* Build and institutionalize performance management frameworks, including goal-setting, quarterly reviews, and annual appraisal cycles.
* Drive succession planning and internal talent mobility to develop a strong leadership pipeline.
* Establish compensation benchmarking and pay equity practices for U.S. and Indian markets, ensuring competitiveness and compliance.

**Branding**

* HR manager will be responsible to be the voice and architect of our talent identity.
* Responsible to influence top talent discover us, create great experience during hiring, ensure employees are connected with King Rose mission every single day.
* Design and execute a comprehensive employer branding strategy that reflects our culture, values, and growth vision.
* Partner with leadership and marketing to craft compelling narratives for careers pages, social media, and recruitment campaigns.
* Build employee advocacy programs that turn our people into brand ambassadors.
* Curate impactful candidate experiences—from the first touchpoint to onboarding—ensuring every interaction reflects our values.
* Use data and analytics to measure brand perception and continuously refine our approach.

**HR Operations & Compliance**

* Maintain and continuously improve HR policies, employee handbooks, and SOPs in compliance with U.S. federal/state labor laws and Indian labor regulations.
* Own the HRIS ecosystem — select, implement, and optimize tools that enable data-driven decision-making across the HR function.
* Lead grievance resolution, disciplinary proceedings, and workplace investigations with professionalism, sensitivity, and legal compliance.
* Manage all offboarding and exit interview processes, deriving insights that inform retention and culture strategies.

**Culture & Employee Experience**

* Champion a high-performance, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture across both the U.S. and India offices.
* Design and lead company-wide onboarding, orientation, and culture-building programs that embed King Rose’s values from day one.
* Build and execute employee engagement strategies — pulse surveys, recognition programs, team events — with measurable outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for employees across all levels on culture, conduct, and career development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA or Master’s in HR strongly preferred.
* HR certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent is a significant advantage.
* Minimum 12–15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or head-of-HR capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading HR operations across India and the U.S. in a multinational or cross-border organization.
* Deep expertise in Indian talent markets — Bangalore/metro sourcing, compensation benchmarking, and labor law compliance (Shops & Establishments Act, PF, ESIC, etc.).
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. employment law, benefits administration
* Proven track record of building HR functions and people infrastructure from the ground up in a scaling organization.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* High proficiency in MS Office Suite and data analysis for HR reporting and workforce planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the construction, interior fit-out, or professional services industry.
* Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company from an India delivery center.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience, with annual performance bonuses and hikes.
* Comprehensive health insurance and benefits package.
* Opportunity to build and lead the HR function from the ground up during an exciting growth phase.
* A smart, collaborative, and mission-driven team that values people as the core of the business.
* Work in a dynamic international environment bridging the best of NYC and Bangalore.

* Develop an understanding of IBM's business, industry, workforce, and HR practices.

* Collaborate effectively with HR colleagues, business stakeholders, employees, and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate clearly and professionally through written and verbal communication.
* Build positive working relationships through transparency, professionalism, and effective collaboration.
* Research HR practices and contribute ideas, insights, reports, and analyses to support team objectives.
* Demonstrate willingness to learn and develop professional HR expertise.
* Leverage collaboration, analytics, digital, and AI-driven technologies to enhance HR effectiveness.
* Support team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and a collaborative work environment.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
**Role 1 : HR Transformation Professional – Product Management**
As an HR Transformation Professional, you will play the role of a Product Manager for HR solutions, shaping digital products that impact employees across the organization.

Leveraging data, AI, automation, and design thinking, you will solve complex workforce challenges and build scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

**Role 2**
:
**HR Business Development Professional**
As an HR Business Development Professional, you will work on strategic business transformation initiatives including outsourcing, acquisitions, divestitures, and workforce integration programs. Partnering with clients, business leaders, and HR teams, you will help assess workforce impacts, develop people-focused solutions, manage transition activities, and support business deals from planning through execution. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy consulting, stakeholder engagement, project management, business analysis, and solving complex organizational challenges at the intersection of people and business strategy
  
  
This role is well-suited for candidates who are passionate about consulting, business transformation, M&A, organizational strategy, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Role 3: HR Compensation Professional**
As a Compensation Professional, you will help shape how IBM attracts, motivates, and retains talent through compensation, rewards, and recognition programs. Working with business leaders, HR, and Finance teams, you will leverage data, market insights, and analytics to evaluate pay practices, benchmark talent, support salary planning, and make evidence-based recommendations that align business goals with employee experience. This role involves data, solving complex business problems, influencing workforce decisions, and understanding how compensation strategy drives organizational success
  
  
Individuals who are interested in leveraging analytics, market intelligence, and business acumen to shape compensation strategies, support workforce decisions, and drive organizational performance through evidence-based insight

As an
**AI Product Manager - HR**
, you will help shape the future of work by designing and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform employee and HR experiences. Working at the intersection of business, technology, data, and automation, you will identify opportunities for innovation, define product requirements, and partner with cross-functional teams to build and scale digital workers, intelligent workflows, and AI-enabled products.
  
  
Individuals with a strong interest in product management, AI, emerging technologies, digital transformation, and data-driven problem solving, who aspire to build innovative solutions that create business impact at scale.
  
  
**Role 5 : HR- Talent Professional – Learning, Leadership & Skills**
As a Talent Professional in HR, you will help shape how IBM develops skills, leaders, and careers in an AI-enabled world. Working across learning, leadership development, skills, and career programs, you will use data, AI, design thinking, and workforce insights to create scalable solutions that help employees learn, grow, and succeed. You will contribute to talent initiatives, analyze workforce trends, build innovative employee experiences, and partner with stakeholders to solve future workforce challenges.
  
  
Role requires strong interest in talent development, learning, workforce skills, leadership, employee experience, and the application of AI and data to solve people and business challenges at scale

As a Learning Consultant, you will partner with business leaders to identify skill gaps and design learning solutions that build critical workforce capabilities. You will translate business priorities into targeted learning strategies, manage the delivery of large-scale upskilling and reskilling programs, and collaborate with global stakeholders to ensure employees have the skills needed for future success. Individuals with a strong interest in learning, workforce development, stakeholder consulting, program management, and skills transformation, who are motivated by creating large-scale impact through capability building and employee growth

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Role Description**

SIIPL is seeking an experienced, proactive, organized, and results-driven Human Resources Manager to oversee recruitment, onboarding, employee administration, attendance, payroll coordination, performance management, HR compliance, employee engagement, workplace discipline, and exit management.

The HR Manager will manage the complete employee lifecycle, coordinate with departmental heads, monitor employee productivity and reporting, and ensure smooth HR operations across corporate offices, sales teams, construction sites, and property management divisions. The role also includes acting as Office Administration Manager in the designated manager's absence.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Recruitment & Manpower Planning

* Plan manpower requirements with department heads.
* Prepare job descriptions and recruitment advertisements.
* Manage hiring through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, agencies, and referrals.
* Screen candidates, conduct interviews, negotiate salaries, and coordinate selections.
* Issue offer letters, appointment letters, and employment agreements.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring reports, costs, and joining ratios.

2. Employee Onboarding & Induction

* Manage joining formalities and verify employee documents.
* Coordinate employee IDs, email accounts, system access, and asset allocation.
* Conduct induction on company policies, responsibilities, and workplace discipline.
* Explain attendance, leave, working hours, breaks, and reporting procedures.
* Coordinate probation objectives and maintain employee records.

3. Attendance & Time Management

* Monitor employee attendance, login/logout timings, punctuality, and breaks.
* Track late arrivals, early departures, absences, and extended breaks.
* Maintain biometric/HRMS attendance records.
* Manage leave applications, balances, approvals, and holiday schedules.
* Coordinate attendance corrections and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

4. Daily EOD & Productivity Monitoring

* Ensure timely submission of daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports.
* Track completed, pending, and delayed employee assignments.
* Coordinate with managers to monitor employee productivity.
* Identify reporting inconsistencies and repeated delays.
* Prepare consolidated productivity and EOD compliance reports.

5. Performance Management

* Establish employee KPIs, KRAs, and performance evaluation systems.
* Coordinate weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reviews.
* Maintain employee scorecards, appraisals, and evaluation records.
* Identify underperformance and implement Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).
* Conduct feedback meetings and performance communications.
* Support promotions, increments, appraisals, and development decisions.
* Ensure fair, objective, and documented evaluations.

6. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits

* Coordinate monthly payroll with Finance and Accounts.
* Verify attendance, leave deductions, overtime, incentives, and salary adjustments.
* Maintain compensation structures and confidential salary records.
* Coordinate applicable PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and TDS requirements.
* Manage reimbursement, bonus, benefits, and increment documentation.
* Resolve payroll-related employee concerns.

7. HR Policies & Workplace Discipline

* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbooks.
* Monitor office etiquette, dress code, professional conduct, and discipline.
* Enforce attendance, working hours, breaks, leave, and reporting policies.
* Address misconduct, grievances, and policy violations.
* Conduct counseling, issue appropriate warnings, and coordinate disciplinary procedures.
* Ensure fair treatment and compliance with applicable laws.

8. Employee Engagement & Culture

* Organize team-building, employee recognition, and engagement activities.
* Coordinate internal celebrations, external events, and company outings.
* Conduct employee feedback surveys and engagement discussions.
* Promote teamwork, motivation, employee retention, and workplace satisfaction.
* Support a positive, professional, and inclusive organizational culture.

9. Training & Employee Development

* Identify training requirements with department heads.
* Organize induction, functional, soft-skills, and leadership training.
* Coordinate sales, customer service, safety, and operational training.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance, and evaluation records.
* Support career development and assess training effectiveness.

10. Employee Relations & Grievances

* Act as the primary HR contact for employee concerns.
* Resolve grievances, conflicts, complaints, and workplace disagreements.
* Facilitate communication between employees, managers, and management.
* Promote respectful communication and fair workplace practices.
* Support harassment prevention and applicable POSH compliance.
* Maintain confidential grievance records.

11. Exit Management & Final Settlement

* Manage resignations, notice periods, and exit interviews.
* Coordinate employee handovers and departmental clearances.
* Recover company assets, documents, devices, and access cards.
* Coordinate IT access deactivation.
* Process exit clearance and coordinate full-and-final settlements with Finance.
* Issue relieving letters and experience certificates.
* Maintain employee attrition and exit analysis reports.

12. Labour Law Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour laws.
* Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax, gratuity, minimum wages, and statutory obligations.
* Maintain employee registers, contracts, and HR documentation.
* Coordinate with labour consultants, auditors, and statutory authorities.
* Support compliance for office, field, construction, and contract personnel.
* Manage statutory reporting, inspections, audits, and renewals.

13. Office Administration & Staff Supervision

* Coordinate office infrastructure, facilities, housekeeping, and employee requirements.
* Support workplace discipline, visitor management, and seating arrangements.
* Coordinate equipment allocation and administrative support.
* Supervise administrative staff when assigned.
* **Act as Office Administration Manager during the designated manager's absence.**
* Manage daily office concerns and escalate major issues to management.

14. Department Coordination & Workforce Management

* Coordinate HR activities across Land Acquisition, Construction, Interiors, Property Management, Sales, Marketing, Finance, IT, and Administration.
* Plan manpower for offices, project sites, and field operations.
* Coordinate site staffing, attendance, documentation, and employee welfare.
* Track vacancies, transfers, deployments, and workforce availability.
* Maintain organizational charts and departmental manpower records.
* Support workforce planning for expansion and new projects.

15. HR Reporting & Management Reviews

* Prepare daily attendance and HR activity reports.
* Submit weekly recruitment, productivity, and performance updates.
* Prepare monthly manpower, payroll, attrition, training, and engagement reports.
* Maintain HR dashboards, employee databases, and performance trackers.
* Present HR observations, concerns, and improvement recommendations.
* Monitor pending HR tasks, compliance, and corrective actions.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Commerce, or Management.
* MBA/PG qualification in HR Management preferred.
* 1–4 years of relevant HR experience preferred.
* Real estate, construction, infrastructure, or corporate HR experience preferred.
* Knowledge of recruitment, payroll, HR operations, employee management, and labour laws.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Excellent organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace, HRMS, and attendance systems.
* Ability to manage confidential information professionally.
* English and Kannada preferred; Tamil, Telugu, or Hindi is an advantage.

title: SR SPECIALIST, DIGITAL OPERATIONS & WEB EXPERIENCE
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary:**

Northern Trust is seeking a Senior Digital Operations & Web Experience Analyst to help build, operate and continuously improve how digital content and experiences are delivered across our owned digital ecosystem.

This is not a traditional web-publishing role. The position combines digital operations, workflow and process optimization, governance, hands-on publishing, quality assurance, performance improvement and cross-functional enablement.

The initial and largest focus will be our global public web ecosystem, where the opportunity to improve operational consistency, scalability and performance is greatest. The broader mandate extends across the owned digital channels and platforms managed by Digital Marketing. You will help establish common workflows, standards and operating practices so content can be created, approved, published, distributed, measured and optimized consistently—regardless of platform or destination.

You will work as an integral member of a global Enterprise Digital organization, partnering with Marketing, Content, Digital Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility, Compliance and business teams.

**Major Duties:**

**Digital workflow and process excellence**
-------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve workflows spanning intake, requirements, prioritization, production, approvals, publishing/distribution, QA, measurement and optimization.
* Map current-state processes and identify bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, duplication, control gaps and sources of rework.
* Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, checklists, service expectations, decision criteria and escalation paths.
* Use operational data to improve cycle time, throughput, quality and predictability.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work through process redesign, automation and platform integration.

**Owned digital publishing and delivery**
-----------------------------------------

* Independently manage complex digital requests and releases from intake through post-launch validation.
* Author, maintain and publish content in Adobe Experience Manager or a comparable enterprise CMS.
* Support enterprise websites, landing pages, insights and thought-leadership experiences, product and solution content, localized experiences and other owned digital destinations.
* Manage content and asset requirements including metadata, taxonomy, tagging, approvals, localization and lifecycle.
* Promote approved templates, reusable components and structured-content practices that enable scale.

**Standards, governance and risk reduction**
--------------------------------------------

* Help define, document, operationalize and maintain digital publishing and delivery standards.
* Translate UX, design-system, accessibility, SEO, analytics, content, privacy, compliance and technology requirements into practical procedures.
* Establish and apply QA and release-readiness practices.
* Identify inconsistent practices, unnecessary customization and workarounds that create operational risk, technical debt or fragmented experiences.
* Coordinate exceptions with the appropriate Product, Technology, Design or control owner.

**Quality and experience assurance**
------------------------------------

* Perform and improve pre- and post-publication QA.
* Validate content accuracy, page structure, responsive behavior, links, imagery, documents, metadata, accessibility, SEO, analytics and experience requirements.
* Coordinate defect remediation and support regression testing and production validation.
* Analyze recurring defects to identify root causes and preventive improvements.

**Performance and optimization**
--------------------------------

* Partner with Analytics, SEO, UX and Digital Product teams to understand operational, site-health and experience performance.
* Translate insight into prioritized opportunities that improve discoverability, accessibility, usability, engagement and conversion where applicable.
* Support audits, testing and experimentation; validate whether changes deliver the intended result.
* Create a closed loop from publish to measure, learn, optimize and standardize.

**Automation, integration and productivity**
--------------------------------------------

* Identify repetitive tasks and workflow bottlenecks suitable for automation.
* Translate operational problems into requirements for Product, MarTech and Technology teams.
* Support integrations connecting work management, CMS, DAM, analytics and related platforms.
* Participate in implementation, testing, adoption and benefits measurement for workflow and platform enhancements.
* Evaluate responsible AI-enabled improvements where they solve a defined operational problem and preserve quality and controls.

**Cross-functional partnership and enablement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Serve as an operational bridge between business requirements and digital execution.
* Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, Content, Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility and control teams.
* Explain standards, platform constraints and operating requirements in clear business terms.
* Support onboarding, training and change adoption for publishers, contributors and stakeholders.
* Surface systemic problems and improvement opportunities to Digital leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Digital Marketing, Marketing Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in digital operations, web operations, digital production, content operations, marketing operations or digital-experience delivery.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise websites, content-management platforms or complex digital ecosystems; Adobe Experience Manager strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning or improving end-to-end digital workflows.
* Experience developing or improving SOPs, governance practices, QA standards or operational controls.
* Experience coordinating complex work across business and technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, SEO, analytics, UX, content lifecycle and web-performance fundamentals.
* Experience using operational or performance data to identify problems and improve outcomes.
* Strong prioritization, documentation, facilitation, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a global, matrixed organization.

**Preferred**

* Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets; Adobe Workfront or a comparable work-management platform.
* Adobe Analytics and/or Google Analytics 4.
* Global, multilingual or multisite content operations; localization, translation or MSM experience.
* WCAG accessibility, technical/on-page SEO and Core Web Vitals knowledge.
* Workflow automation, systems integration, structured-content or content-supply-chain experience.
* Agile delivery, experimentation, personalization or conversion-optimization exposure.
* Financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.
